name: Fast Cache Estimator
definition: An unbiased estimator for incoming radiance that reduces computational cost by querying volume density for N points but only evaluating the physically-based appearance at K << N points, drawn from a categorical distribution based on render weights.
summary: The Fast Cache Estimator is an unbiased Monte Carlo method that reduces computational cost by decoupling density queries from appearance evaluations, sampling only a subset of points for appearance based on render weights.
